question: The SI unit of electric charge is a __ __ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Coulomb**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Coulomb

 
 
• The SI Unit of Charge is Coulomb.
 
• It is denoted as C.
 
• The coulomb is defined as the quantity of electricity transported in one second by a current of one ampere.​
